results.remarks: Do not miss this opportunity to own this home, perfectly located inside Terra Lago. The modern and functional floorplan offers open living. The Living room and dining area offers plenty of space for entertaining. Downstairs office/den is large enough to use as the 5th bedroom and is close to the downstairs bathroom. The family room is open to the large kitchen and offers plenty of light and access to the rear yard. The kitchen has a bar top island, gas cooktop, dishwasher, microwave and oven. Plenty of counter space and cabinets makes this kitchen easy to work small to large meals in, and plenty of storage in the pantry. The stairs and upstairs flooring is done in a beautiful wood flooring. The primary bedroom has plenty of space and has direct access to the large bathroom, offering a shower, soaking tub, dual sinks, and a large walk-in closet. Bonus room off the primary is located at the top of the stairs. Secondary bedrooms are perfect with ceiling fans and walk-in closets. Upstairs bathroom is located close to the bedrooms and offers two vanity, tub/shower.  The home has two upgraded Lennox AC systems, whole house fan and a 2-ton mini split in the garage. The home has a leased solar system with low monthly payment making the electricity reasonable all year round. The rear yard is low maintenance with desert landscaping, covered patio, outdoor kitchen, and salt water hot tub. The covered outdoor kitchen is fully equipped for all your needs. Large Stainless-Steel BBQ with rotisserie, Stainless Flat top gas griddle, Ceramic smoker grill, warming drawer, Stone Pizza oven, Smoker, Double sink, refrigerator, Stainless- Steel cooler, TV, and bar top seating for about 10 people. The outdoor kitchen is covered with insulated roof with lights and ceiling fans. The salt water Hot Springs spa is located on the side yard and is covered with an insulated roof and has a mounted TV to enjoy while in spa. The rear yard offers plenty of shade and privacy to enjoy the yard. The property has many types of fruit trees; Mexican lime, blood orange, red grapefruit, tangerine, pomegranate, oranges, and fig trees. The community offers community pool and spa all year round, clubhouse, gym, Billard room, kids play area and 24-hour guard gated community and patrol. The community also includes cable (DirectTV), fast internet, and beautiful grounds to walk and enjoy the desert. The lake allows electric boats and non motored watercraft.

results.remarks: Single-story living, no HOA, and a backyard built for desert evenings - this Whittier Ranch home suits a full-time residence, second home, or investment property. On a 7,841 square foot lot, the home offers 1,914 square feet with 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, plus a flexible bonus space suited for a home office, formal dining room, or potential 4th bedroom. Parking is abundant, with a 3-car tandem attached garage, a covered carport, and extended driveway space all on the property. A stucco exterior with tile roofing and a covered front porch with an arched entry lead into the home, where tile flooring runs throughout with no carpet anywhere. The open-concept layout connects the living area directly to the kitchen, which features granite countertops, a large center island with seating, stainless steel appliances including a gas range, built-in microwave, and refrigerator, and a built-in desk nook. Ceiling fans are installed throughout, and central air conditioning serves the property. The primary suite includes a tray ceiling and an ensuite bathroom with dual sinks, a soaking tub, and a separate glass-enclosed shower, while the guest bedrooms share a Jack-and-Jill bathroom and a half bath serves the remaining living space. Outside, a large covered rear patio spans the width of the home, opening to a grass lawn, mature palm trees, string lighting, and a seating area, and the Whittier Ranch community includes a park with a shaded playground. The property is close to the Empire Polo Club, site of the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival and Stagecoach Festival, with grocery stores, retail shopping, dining, and Fantasy Springs Resort Casino nearby, and it falls within the Desert Sands Unified School District; proximity to the festival grounds also makes this a candidate for seasonal or short-term rental use, subject to any applicable city rental regulations. Schedule a showing to see the layout, finishes, and outdoor space firsthand.

results.remarks: REDUCED!!! And Now a New Air conditioner!!!Welcome to this beautifully upgraded Inspiration model located in phase 3 of Sun City Shadow Hills. Enter through the decorative glass door into a spacious Great Room featuring a custom built-in entertainment center and book shelving, creating the perfect setting for relaxing or entertaining. There is tile flooring throughout, except for carpet in one guest bedroom, and recessed lighting. This thoughtfully designed home offers three bedrooms and two bathrooms, with the expansive primary suite privately separated from the guest bedrooms. The primary bath features dual vanities and a walk-in closet complete with custom built-ins. The gourmet kitchen opens to the dining area and showcases a large center island with granite countertops, stainless sink, pendant lighting, under cabinet lighting, tile backsplash, gas cooktop range, microwave, and hidden trash drawer. The kitchen refrigerator, washer, dryer are all included, along with ceiling fans throughout the home. Additional highlights include an indoor laundry room leading to a spacious garage with epoxy flooring, air conditioning, storage racks and a newer Navien tankless water heater. Step outside to the entertainer's backyard featuring an extended patio and numerous palm trees offering a peaceful desert retreat. Residents of this premier active adult community enjoy an exceptional lifestyle with: Two golf courses(Championship and Par-3) Two clubhouses, Two fitness centers, a Ballroom and activity rooms and a Billiards room. There is an Indoor Lap pool and spa plus two outdoor resort-style pools and spas, Pickleball, Tennis, and Bocce Courts, and numerous clubs, activities, and social events. The Santa Rosa clubhouse is nearby with fitness center, indoor walking track, and Bistro. The low HOA dues include internet service, making this home an incredible value in one of the desert's most sought-after 55+ communities!

results.remarks: Welcome to this beautifully upgraded Connect floorplan located in the highly desirable 55+ community of Trilogy Polo Club. This thoughtfully designed single-story home offers 3 bedrooms plus a versatile den, ideal for additional guests, a home office, hobby space, or flexible living. The open-concept kitchen is a true standout, featuring GE Cafe Series stainless steel appliances, including a gas rangetop. The space is beautifully finished with quartz countertops, full backsplash, an oversized island, and upgraded cabinetry with soft-close drawers.The primary suite serves as a relaxing retreat with a spa-style shower, upgraded bath finishes, and a bay window that fills the space with natural light. Additional interior highlights include owned solar, reverse osmosis (soft water to the entire home), upgraded tile plank flooring, LED recessed lighting, under-cabinet kitchen lighting, contemporary interior doors and trim, mini split A/C unit and cabinetry in the 2-car garage, and a multi-slide glass door that seamlessly blends indoor and outdoor living.Step outside to enjoy the extended backyard with mountain views, perfect for entertaining, relaxing, or creating your own outdoor oasis. Two drop down electronic shades are built in to the outdoor space for additional sun protection or to create an outdoor living space.Residents of Trilogy Polo Club enjoy a highly social, easy-to-plug-into lifestyle with scenic walking paths and access to resort-style amenities including the clubhouse, fitness center, resort and lap pools, pickleball and tennis courts, golf simulator, social clubs, and the on-site public restaurant, June Hill's Table. Conveniently located approximately 7 minutes from shopping, dining, and grocery stores, this home offers both connection and everyday convenience.This home offers the perfect blend of modern design, thoughtful builder upgrades, and resort-style living in one of the desert's most sought-after active adult communities.

results.remarks: This expanded Lennar built Merion model in Heritage Palms Country Club is one of the community's most sought after floor plans, and for good reason. From its inviting front courtyard to the expansive golf course and mountain views beyond, it offers the kind of indoor outdoor desert living buyers are searching for.The welcoming courtyard, complete with mature landscaping, paver walkway, seating areas, and a peaceful fountain, creates a warm first impression and an additional outdoor living space to enjoy year round.Inside, the open main living area captures sweeping golf course views and distant clubhouse vistas the moment you enter. Beautiful tile flooring runs throughout the great room and main living spaces, adding both elegance and durability, while hardwood flooring in the kitchen brings warmth and character.The great room is anchored by a stunning custom built in designed to accommodate a large screen TV while showcasing art, books, and collectibles. results.remarks:
NEW PRICE IMPROVEMENT!! Resort-Style Living in Palazzo



Welcome to this spacious single-story home in the desirable Palazzo community, offering 3 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, a formal dining room, and a flexible den that can serve as a home office or covert to 4th bedroom, media room, or additional living space. As well as a spacious 3 car garage   



Designed for both everyday comfort and entertaining, the open-concept floor plan features a large great room with a cozy fireplace and an upgraded kitchen complete with a center island, abundant cabinetry, pantry, and generous counter space.



Thoughtful upgrades include a whole-house water softener, kitchen water purification system, tankless water heater, and dual HVAC systems, including a newer unit dedicated to the bedroom wing.



Step outside to your private backyard retreat featuring a sparkling saltwater pool and spa, expansive paver patio, and gas fire pit—perfect for relaxing evenings or entertaining guests year-round.



With spacious living areas, modern upgrades, and resort-style outdoor amenities, this home offers the best of desert living.

results.remarks: Resort-style living awaits in the guard-gated community of Indian Palms Country Club! This beautifully maintained 3-bedroom plus bonus room, 2.5-bath home offers an impressive 2,495 square feet of living space and is perfectly positioned on the golf course, delivering peaceful fairway views and the ultimate indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Step inside to discover a spacious, open floor plan designed for both everyday comfort and effortless entertaining. The expansive kitchen features abundant cabinetry, generous counter space, a center island with bar seating, stainless steel appliances, and seamlessly flows into the dining area and great room. A separate formal dining room provides the perfect setting for holiday gatherings, while the versatile bonus room offers endless possibilities as a game room, media room, home office, or additional living space. The spacious primary suite serves as a private retreat with direct backyard access, while two additional guest bedrooms provide comfortable accommodations for family and friends. A well-appointed laundry room with extensive cabinetry, built-in workspace, and abundant storage adds exceptional functionality. The backyard is designed for year-round enjoyment with a sparkling pool and raised spa, expansive patios, and a stunning custom outdoor kitchen complete with a built-in BBQ, griddle, sink, refrigerator, granite countertops, and a covered pergola--perfect for hosting friends while overlooking the lush golf course. Whether you're enjoying your morning coffee, relaxing poolside, or entertaining under the stars, this backyard is truly the highlight of the home. Additional features include a 3-car garage, plantation shutters, mature desert landscaping, abundant storage throughout, and a leased Tesla solar system with monthly payments of just $177, helping improve energy efficiency and reduce utility costs. Indian Palms Country Club offers resort-style amenities including a 27-hole championship golf course, community pools and spas, tennis and pickleball courts, a fitness center, clubhouse, and 24-hour guard-gated security. Conveniently located just minutes from the Empire Polo Club--home to the world-famous Coachella and Stagecoach music festivals--as well as shopping, dining, casinos, and endless entertainment, this exceptional property is ideal as a full-time residence, seasonal getaway, or investment opportunity.
